extracted.intended_audience: business leaders, B Corps, marketers, and stakeholders interested in B Corp certification and consumer behavior
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of B Lab's report on international awareness of the B Corp brand, highlighting generational patterns, regional trends, and the brand's impact on consumer behavior and business strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand awareness level
rubrics_metrics.description: Across regions surveyed, B Lab’s studies show that 1 in 4 consumers have now heard of B Corps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure overall percentage of consumers who have heard of the B Corp brand; track this metric over time as an indicator of reach and recognition. The page frames this as a strong baseline that is continuing to grow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generational awareness
rubrics_metrics.description: Younger audiences are more aware of B Corps than their older counterparts; for example, half of Americans aged 25 and younger are now familiar with B Corps, and globally those under 40 consistently demonstrate greater awareness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Segment awareness metrics by age cohort (e.g., Gen Z, under 40) to detect shifting values and purchasing behaviors. Use generational differences to target messaging and measure impact on younger demographics specifically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional density effect (Strength in numbers)
rubrics_metrics.description: The more B Corps in a region, the greater the awareness of the brand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess the relationship between local/regional count of certified B Corps and local awareness levels. This suggests strategies that grow regional certification density (new B Corps, regional clusters) can create positive ripple effects on brand recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Influence on consumer behavior / purchase intent
rubrics_metrics.description: The data reveals a strong correlation between awareness of the B Corp brand and purchasing decisions; consumers who recognize the B Corp certification are significantly more likely to purchase from certified businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare purchase likelihood or actual sales among consumers who recognize the certification versus those who do not. Treat awareness as a predictor of consumer choice and a practical business lever to increase sales.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community collaboration and joint marketing
rubrics_metrics.description: Case studies within the report showcase how collaborative efforts among B Corps—such as joint marketing campaigns or community events—can boost brand visibility and consumer engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate and promote collaborative initiatives (joint campaigns, events) as mechanisms for increasing visibility. Use case studies and examples to demonstrate replicable tactics; measure engagement uplift attributable to collaborative activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consumer expectations for accountability and transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: As awareness continues to grow, consumers—especially younger generations—demand greater accountability and transparency from businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat accountability and transparency as required attributes for companies leveraging the B Corp brand; include measures of perceived transparency/accountability in brand health tracking and ensure business practices align with heightened consumer expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awareness as a strategic asset for mission impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Awareness of the B Corp brand is a key asset to B Lab's mission: it allows mobilization of business leaders, influence on policymakers, and galvanizing of consumers to demand more from businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position awareness metrics as inputs to broader advocacy and systems-change goals (policy influence, leader mobilization). Track downstream outcomes (policy engagement, leader participation) that may be enabled by higher awareness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awareness growth trend
rubrics_metrics.description: B Corp brand awareness is strong, and growing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor temporal trends in awareness to identify momentum and inform strategy. Combine trend analysis with demographic and regional breakdowns to understand where growth is accelerating and where additional investment is needed.
